files.purpose: Configure a Jac 0.36.1 local backend project with main.jac entry point and no npm dependencies.

Define source-grounded ProjectSummary, SessionSummary, TrajectoryNode, SubagentRef fields. Implement list_projects, list_sessions and _summarize_session. Project files live under <claude_root>/projects/<encoded-name>/*.jsonl; skip directories without sessions; sort projects by last_activity descending. For each JSONL record, skip bad lines, count user/assistant messages and tool_use blocks, take first user text, ai-title, latest timestamp and first gitBranch, and get file size.
Import TrajectoryNode and SubagentRef from store.jac. Recursively search a node's children by id, returning None if absent. Look up a SubagentRef by node ID in a dict, returning None if missing.

signatures.findNode: def:pub findNode(treeRoot: TrajectoryNode, nodeId: str) -> TrajectoryNode | None
signatures.subagentRefFor: def:pub subagentRefFor(nodeId: str, subagentByNodeId: dict) -> SubagentRef | None

files.purpose: Import public store and tree utilities as a small application/library entry point; no UI route.

verify.flow: discover projects -> list sessions -> inspect tree
verify.steps: Run jac check on main.jac and Jac behavior tests with temporary JSONL fixtures. Compare source-derived independent assertions, then replay actual harness calls from a clean workspace.

assumption: Unmodified source store.jac and treeUtils.jac passed Jac 0.36.1 check and two source-derived tests in an isolated project.
